context: M21 o10. Corwin lobby, midnight. Bernard reads with a magnifying glass. Hollis's radio plays softly.

lines.speaker: char.bernard_ostrow
lines.text: Notwithstanding. Heretofore. Consideration. It's him. Every page is his voice.

lines.speaker: char.bernard_ostrow
lines.text: Twenty hotels, Mr. Arce. Ours is page nine. Mrs. Pruitt is a 'unit'.

lines.speaker: char.odessa_pruitt
lines.text: Then we're not a unit. We're a page. Pages can be read in court.

lines.speaker: char.teddy_arce
lines.text: And the first page is Carl's. And mine. I was in the car.
